verdict.rationale: The pnpm README pairs its speed claim with a published benchmark section. A community report quotes specific numbers from pnpm's own benchmarks: clean install with lockfile about 3x faster (7s -> 2.2s) and no-op install about 29x faster. Independent users add their own measurements, such as CI installs of 15s vs 35s. Missing for 10: the benchmark data and methodology themselves in first-party evidence (the pack only shows a link reference), and a breakdown across scenarios and competitors.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see published benchmarks or measured numbers backing the manager's speed claims

citations.quote: Up to 2x faster than the alternatives (see [benchmark](#benchmark)).
their benchmarks report a clean install with lockfile is about 3x faster (7s -> 2.2s) and a no-op install is about 29x faster (517ms -> 18ms).
Speed difference is 15s vs 35s for our use case which is pretty significant.
